SELECT

  , (current_revenue - revenue_prev_month)*100/revenue_prev_month AS revenue_growth_mom
FROM (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(subq_5.metric_time__day, subq_15.metric_time__day) AS metric_time__day
    , MAX(subq_5.current_revenue) AS current_revenue
    , MAX(subq_15.revenue_prev_month) AS revenue_prev_month
  FROM (
    SELECT
      metric_time__day
      , SUM(__revenue) AS current_revenue
    FROM sma_10002_cte
    GROUP BY
      metric_time__day
  ) subq_5
  FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT
      time_spine_src_10000.date_day AS metric_time__day
      , subq_9.__revenue AS revenue_prev_month

    INNER JOIN (
